title: Eleven Winters and One Bridge
subtitle: 工程建造 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）
meta: 主题语境：工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）　|　核心词汇：construction　|　正文 324 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 construction 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1954 my great-uncle ① began a construction that took eleven winters, and he said the beginning was the whole of the planning. The ② construction, meaning the building and not the drawing, stood on one bank and stayed there; construction, he said, is the only thing on a river that is judged by how many winters it takes.

Every ③ construction in that county had the same foreman, and the ④ construction at the end, meaning the one he kept for the bridge and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever crossed twice. Construction, my grandmother said, is nine parts foreman and one part somebody willing to finish; my great-uncle said the finishing is the part that fills the winter.

My mother meant the other thing entirely: she said ⑤ the construction was the whole of the sentence, meaning the structure and not the building. The ⑥ construction, meaning the structure and not any of that, is the only thing in a sentence that everybody uses and nobody names; construction, she said, is either something you begin or the only word that means both a building and a structure. He said the structure is the part they remember.

By 1962 the ⑦ construction had become a line in an account, and the account had become an argument about the foreman. The ⑧ construction of the whole thing, my great-uncle wrote in February, was one bank and thirty years of finishing; construction, he said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to plan. She said the planning was never mentioned.

The ⑨ construction I remember is the one at the end, which was finished in 1968 and is still described as the slowest in the county. A ⑩ construction, my grandmother said in 1970, is the only thing that improves by being finished; every construction, she said, is a structure that has agreed to look like a building. She said the structure was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 建造物（指那一座建筑本身，与那张图纸相对）
C. 固定搭配：begin a construction 开始一项建造工程
D. n. 工程（指那个郡里每一项）
E. n. 工程（指末尾那一项）
F. n. 结构；句法结构（指句子的结构）
G. n. 工程（指账目里提到的那一项）
H. n. 施工；营建（抽象总称）

items.q: began a construction that took eleven winters
The construction, meaning the building and not the drawing
the construction was the whole of the sentence
the construction had become a line in an account
The construction of the whole thing
A construction, my grandmother said in 1970

answers.why: begin a construction 意为“开始一项建造工程”，1954 年姑祖父开始了一项花了十一个冬天的建造工程。
construction 意为“建造物”，指那一座建筑本身而不是那张图纸，它立在一岸，并且留在那儿。
construction 指那个郡里每一项工程，每一项都是同一个工头带的。
construction 指末尾那一项（他留给桥的那一项），是唯一有人走过两次的。
construction 意为“结构、句法结构”，母亲说结构就是那个句子的全部，指的是句法结构而不是那座建筑。
construction 为另一个义项，指句子的结构而不是那座建筑，是句子里人人都用、却无人说破的东西。
construction 意为“工程”，指账目里提到的那一项，到 1962 年这项工程成了账目里的一行。
construction 意为“施工、营建”，姑祖父二月写道，整件事的营建是一岸土地三十年的收尾。
construction 意为“建造、建筑物”，我记得的是末尾那一项，1968 年完工，至今仍被说成全县最慢的。
construction 为抽象总称，祖母说一项工程是唯一会因为被完成而变好的东西。
